thread:
Alma (Sales Eng): Zenbox sent an RFI asking for a 10-day POC in their US-only environment. Requirements: baseline 2 GPUs, burst to 5, SOC2 evidence, KMIP HSM option, per-route cost breakdown, and a capability matrix mapped to their control IDs. They want a non-binding estimate + a minimal infra snippet by EOD.

Rafael (AE): Do they require private VPC peering or is dedicated hosted acceptable? Also confirm data retention clause for PII.

Alma (Sales Eng): They prefer peering into their VPC and want PII logs auto-deleted after 30 days, with an option for paid extended retention. We'll offer a promo: 40% off compute for the 10-day POC and waive onboarding.

Jun (SRE): Private peering doable. ETA ~36-48h to stand up initial nodes. KMIP/HSM will need a 5-7 day lead + SOW. Minimal bootstrap for their infra team:
```bash
# run on Zenbox bastion
curl -fsSL https://peering.redwood.ai/agent/bootstrap -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" | sudo bash -s -- --env zenbox-poc --cidr 10.90.8.0/22
```
I'll need contact email + exact CIDR + preferred burst windows.

Hana (Solutions): Uploaded attachments: zenbox_matrix_v1.xlsx and zenbox_rfi_answers_v1.pdf. Matrix highlights: model catalog, quant profiles, prefix KV caching, routing/fallback, telemetry, and per-route token cost. I'll also attach a redacted SOC2.

Rafael (AE): Ballpark non-binding numbers, Jun? Need a figure to include in the RFI reply.

Jun (SRE): Quick non-binding ballpark: 2xA100-eq reserved ~ $9k/month; burst ~$16/GPU-hr; egress ~$0.09/GB. With 40% promo for 10 days estimate ~$700-$1.4k depending on burst use. HSM integration and customer certs add fees and lead time.

security-bot: SOC2 Type II (redacted) attached.

Alma (Sales Eng): Perfect. Rafael, I'll draft the email with Hana's attachments, Jun's snippet, and the non-binding quote. Add trial limits: 10 days, max burst 5 GPUs, trial support level. Any objections?

Rafael (AE): Approved. Send and flag legal for the US-only/data-deletion clause.

Jun (SRE): I'll queue the trial workspace once Zenbox confirms CIDR. Provisioning ETA ~46 hours after kickoff. :rocket:
